stepTitle: Given that we apply a force of $$50\, \text{N}$$ to the nail puller, the nail puller applies $$1250\, \text{N}$$ to the nail, and the nail puller has a mass of $$2.10\, \text{kg}, $$ how much force does the nail puller apply to the supporting surface? Give the force to the nearest newton (in $$\text{N})$$.
